hero.subtitle: Post your job once. We match you with vetted UAE suppliers who compete with anonymous quotes. Compare price, rating and track record, then reveal only the one you choose.

how.title: Three steps to the right supplier
how.sub: No calls, no chasing. The platform does the work and keeps you anonymous until you decide.

steps.title: Describe your job
steps.body: Tell the Smart Engine what you need — text, voice or a photo — and it asks the right questions.

steps.title: Get matched quotes
steps.body: Vetted suppliers compete with anonymous quotes. Compare price, rating and track record side by side.

steps.title: Reveal & start
steps.body: Pay just 3% on the one you choose. Their details are revealed; the rest stay hidden.

why.title: Built to protect you
why.sub: Privacy isn't a luxury — it's what gets you a fair price and zero hassle.

items.title: Your identity stays private
items.body: Suppliers quote without knowing who you are. No cold calls, no inbox flooding.

items.title: Fair, competitive pricing
items.body: Because suppliers compete without seeing each other, you see real market prices.

items.title: Vetted suppliers only
items.body: Every supplier holds a valid UAE trade licence, verified before they quote.

items.title: You're in control
items.body: Compare at your pace and reveal only when ready. Choose one, or none.

cats.title: Every speciality in one platform
cats.sub: From fit-out to CCTV to landscaping — 30+ categories of vetted suppliers.

cta.title: Your next quote is minutes away
cta.sub: Post your job free and watch vetted suppliers compete for it. You only pay 3% when you reveal the one you choose.

footer.tagline: The UAE's anonymous quote marketplace. Post once, compare vetted suppliers, and reveal only the one you choose.
